start: Gym page of a gym with one owner; HQ signed in within 15 minutes; owner called on the gym's number

steps.action: Tick 'I called the gym’s own number and the owner confirmed', click 'Make a new sign-in code'
user_sees: 'For <owner>, <mobile>.' and 'The owner’s sign-in code (works once, for 30 minutes):' with the code
must_not: A code for another person of the gym

steps.action: Click 'Copy the message' and send it on WhatsApp yourself
must_not: HQ sending a message on its own

steps.action: Pick the owner in 'Which owner' ('<name> (<mobile>)'), tick, click 'Make a new sign-in code'
user_sees: The code card for the picked owner
must_not: The code made for the first owner instead

steps.action: Click 'Make a new sign-in code' without the tick
must_not: A code made without the call

steps.action: HQ signed in over 15 minutes ago: tick and click
user_sees: A note to sign in again and a button 'Sign in again'
must_not: A code made on an old sign-in

steps.action: The owner signs in with it
user_sees: The owner is asked to set a new PIN; the old PIN no longer works

steps.action: The owner tries the same code again

must_not: The code in the HQ log or shown again after a reload
A code given without the call the promise names
